findings.mechanism: Correlation IDs are generated per service and not propagated via transport, violating 03-correlation-ids. Logs cannot be queried per request.
findings.remediation: Add a request‑level correlation ID (e.g., W3C traceparent) to the context and include it in all log calls and DB queries.
findings.arithmetic: No numeric threshold; the failure is binary – either a request ID is present in logs or not. The absence means on‑call cannot retrieve all logs for a request.
